rationale_summary: The grounded norms fall into two parallel sets: one for accredited properties (Chapter 3) and one for registered establishments (Chapter 4). Within each set, the overarching system-of-controls provision and the specific pest/contaminant provisions jointly support the same CP criterion. Additionally, within each set, the specific control manner provision specialises the general condition provision. No cumulative or alternative relationships are warranted because the CP does not explicitly require separate independent dimensions; all provisions operationalise the single broad requirement.
